one_sentence: This document presents a visual sketch explainer template for the Theophysics Blackboard, enabling dynamic redrawing and PNG export.
executive_summary: The Theophysics Blackboard is a visual sketch explainer tool designed to support the Theophysics Research Initiative. It provides a template for creating custom titles and subtitles, with a redraw function for fresh sketch variations and retina-ready PNG download at 1800x1040px. The document serves as a core article with supporting evidence and broader context, facilitating the communication of theophysics concepts through visual means.
short_summary: This document is a visual sketch explainer template for the Theophysics Blackboard. Its core structural claim is that dynamic visual sketches enhance understanding of theophysics concepts. Key evidence includes the redraw function and high-resolution PNG export. This matters because it provides a practical tool for researchers to illustrate and share complex ideas.
